title: RBI issues Final directions on Trade Receivables Discounting System (TReDS)
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has today issued Reserve Bank of India (Trade Receivables Discounting System) Directions, 2026. RBI had placed the draft Reserve Bank of India (Trade Receivables Discounting System) Directions, 2026 on April 08, 2026, in the public domain for stakeholder feedback.
